summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Shiksha Sakhi (शिक्षा सखी), a gamified exam-preparation web app featuring a winding learning path ladder, neatly organized TG TET 2025 official PYQs with English/Telugu bilingual toggle, inline contextual AI explanations directly below quiz options, streaks and treasure chest milestones, an all-India government exam selector with Coming Soon directory, and a 30-day free trial transitioning to a Rs 150 (Rs 100 with referral) subscription model.
